d:
C.I.D.Moosa is a Malayalam film directed by Johnny Antony. Dileep plays the hero and he himself produces the film. Bhavana plays his heroine. The film also stars Harishree Ashokan, Cochin Haneefa, Jagathy Sreekumar, Oduvil Unnikrishnan,Saleem Kumar etc. It was remade in Tamil as Seena Thaana 007 but it failed to receive any success that this film had received.
Cast
• Dileep....Moolamkuzhi Sahadevan
• Ashish Vidyarthi....Police Commissioner
• Jagathy Sreekumar....Peethambaran
• Bhavana...Meena
